_comment_campaign_objective: A WRAP campaign. Scope composes exactly as a PORT campaign's would:
its external closure, and the `api` view carries what `api_headers`
DECLARES. What `wrap` changes is the dag: no body is walked (every symbol
contributes its signature only, exactly as an imported symbol does under
`port`), and only a struct DEFINED in `api_headers` keeps its field
layout — its fields ARE the API. Everything else orders as an opaque
handle, which is the right shape for wrapping.
`query ... --api-only` is what this campaign schedules on: declaration-
site membership is the right test for a public header, whose declared
bodies live in the root .c files. `query dag --full` reads the same tree
as if the objective were `port`, without editing this file.
Ownership analysis is unaffected either way: ptr_args/ptr_ret come from
the T2 tables, which cover the whole database regardless of scope.
